title: 瑞银胡一帆：万亿资本注入，能否撬动经济新动能？
speaker: Yifan Hu

segments.en: I think that we see like, we probably September, we already see some of the like, the early signs for the capital injection on the, like a S.O.E. banks and on the insurance companies.
segments.zh: 我认为，大概在九月，我们已经看到一些早期迹象，比如对国有银行和保险公司的资本注入。

segments.en: I think that could expand, that could increase the tier one capital, like the level and also could help like for the bank lending expansion.
segments.zh: 这可能会扩大一级资本规模，并有助于银行信贷扩张。

segments.en: And also like we also say for the CIT Council and DRC, they jointly announced several like for the network investment, like our projects. So we think the investment could pick up like this year because they target to seven trillion of the investment in the six networks.
segments.zh: 另外，发改委等部门联合宣布了多个网络投资项目。我们认为今年这些投资可能会回升，因为目标是六大网络领域七万亿的投入。

segments.en: So currently we have the YTD, we have the actual investment is negative, around seven percent. If we have the seven trillion increase, so that could bring the like the investment up to seven percent of the growth for the whole year.
segments.zh: 目前年初至今实际投资为负，大约负7%。如果实现七万亿增量，可能带动全年投资增长达到7%。

segments.en: But of course, if we take some number in the middle, so the investment will like a return to the like three to four percent. And also with the capital injection, we could also expect for the credit growth, we also increase like a one to two like a percent point.
segments.zh: 当然，如果取中间值，投资增速可能回到3%到4%。同时，资本注入也可能推动信贷增长提升1到2个百分点。

segments.en: So given all this and we think the GDP growth probably will pick up like in the September and then will be accelerated for the first quarter. So the whole year, we still think that China can reach its GDP target.
segments.zh: 综合来看，我们认为GDP增长可能在九月回升，并在第一季度加速。全年来看，我们仍然认为中国能够实现其GDP目标。
